notes.title: Title Updated and New Release Date Set!
notes.content:
Welcome to Changa!

With a new title comes some much needed decompression time, social media creation, and a chance to give the game more time in development. I am excited to conduct testing through Steam and get the best feedback possible going forward. I appreciate all of the interest and support! There are so many things coming!

notes.title: Delayed
notes.content:
Delayed

Jaded will be delayed due to a title conflict

Unfortunately, launch will be delayed as a Steam game title conflict was brought to my attention. I am in talks with the wonderful dev team involved with the other Jaded that plans to release in about 1 week. I am taking a look at all of my options and will post announcement when things have been decided.

Thank you for your interest in this game!

Be in touch shortly!

notes.title: Jaded 0.0.1.08 First Person Update
notes.content:
Jaded

Patch 0.0.1.08

First Person

First person mode is something that has come and gone. Today it comes back with all of the bugs ironed out. Toggled with D-pad Up, the first person mode has all of the same feel and controls as third person mode, but offers a new experience and some utility! Feedback is always appreciated!

Flying Controls

Flying mode is activated when you hold Right Bumper to aim. Use right stick to dash and propel yourself, left stick to aim. Flying felt a little unruly compared to other modes. It has been tightened up and is now a very useful mechanic in all situations.

Thank you for all of the play sessions and feedback!

notes.title: Jaded Patch 0.0.1.07
notes.content:
Jaded

Patch 0.0.1.07


Critical Fixes:

Fixed critical crash that happened after death or win that was related to a delay node. Thanks Pathways345 and ThatDamnVato


Maps

Fixed lockon persisting through meshes and environment.

Rites has a new layout to address the inconsistent bottom of the map.

Rites enemy numbers have been readjusted to be more inline with the previous maps.

Desire and Ill Will had updates to the sky material to better reflect their intended vibe.

Removed platforms in the beginning of maps.

Jade

180 speed increased and vertical Z impulse decreased yielding in better feel.

Camera changes highlight movement across the screen, aid in preventing viewer eye strain, and allow for more control. Aiming transition has been smoothed.

Holding RB to aim now has an option to invert controls in the Input Menu.

Jade now spawns into the map with an audio and visual effect. Thanks Heathen_Rite

Aiming camera speed has been slowed slightly to ease the shaking caused by collisions with the environment.

Dash back, toward the camera, now has more range. Thank you ThatDamnVato

Omitted from last patch was a Dagger size increase to help visual pickup and collisions.

Enemy

Gatekeeper audio ducking is more pronounced. Thank you ThatDamnVato

Yellow enemy type fixes for shooting and pathing.

Auditory shooting telegraph has been amplified and given more time.

Emissive charge is now more telegraphing. Thank you Kraken_GG

Gatekeeper has been slowed down slightly to help with consistent collisions.

Spawner sounds have been adjusted for spatialization.

Enemy homing projectiles now have a Doppler effect and hum to aid in awareness. 



A massive thank you to all of the support and feedback!

notes.title: 0.0.1.06a - Optional Tutorial, Rites Changes, and Camera Tweaks
notes.content:
Jaded 0.0.1.06a

The newest Jaded patch (0.0.1.06a) improves the UI design on the new tutorial level (accessed by selecting "Beginnings" on the Main Menu), improves camera smoothing during all movement and transitions, and increased the difficulty on the map "Rites".

Tutorial:

A lot of the early feedback so far showcased the need for a tutorial. This optional tutorial has all of the basic information about moves and enemies you will encounter. It provides a space for experimenting with movement and mechanics. It ends with dummy enemy types, 1 hostile enemy spawner, and a Gatekeeper to defeat before you advance.

Camera

During a lot of the transitions between aiming and not aiming, grounded and airborne, and during the 180 rotations, the camera would slightly jitter or hesitate. That has been smoothed out and mostly, if not altogether eliminated.

Rites Map

The map Rites stuck out to me as empty. It is one of the largest maps and had little enemy presence. The number of max possible spawns has been increased. This should also help the difficulty scaling between the maps Rites and Desire.

Thank you for your interest and feedback!
